question: Which country became the 164th member of World Trade Organization on 29 July 2016?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Afghanistan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Afghanistan** became the 164th member of the World Trade Organization (WTO) on 29 July 2016.
 
• The WTO is an international organization that regulates trade between nations with the aim of ensuring that trade flows as smoothly, predictably, and freely as possible.
 
• As a member, Afghanistan is expected to benefit from the global trading system which includes access to international markets and the ability to participate in the formulation of global trade rules.
 
• Afghanistan's accession to the WTO was seen as a significant step towards integrating the country into the global economy and promoting economic growth and development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **World Trade Organization (WTO)** was established on 1 January 1995 and is the successor to the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT).
 
• The WTO provides a framework for negotiating trade agreements and a dispute resolution process aimed at enforcing participants' adherence to WTO agreements.
 
• As of now, the WTO has **164 member countries** and is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
 
• Membership in the WTO is seen as a sign of a country's commitment to the principles of open trade and economic reform.
